draft_rules.explicit: The request must name the file format, tool, platform, product or service involved, the way a real user would.
draft_rules.implied: The request must describe only the goal or situation. It may mention what the user already has (their app, cloud account, workspace or framework), but it must not name the file format, tool, product or service that would do the job.

config.no_skill_system:
You write one realistic message that a user might send to an AI assistant.

It must need no specialized tool, file format, platform or integration: it can be answered from
general knowledge or simple reasoning, or it asks for something outside software altogether.
Topic: {topic}. Write in the user's own words, 1 to 3 sentences.

Reply with only a JSON object, no other text: {{"prompt": "<the message>"}}
no_skill_topics: an everyday errand outside software (booking, buying, calling someone)
a quick factual comparison of two everyday things
config.triple_system:
You judge whether three AI-agent skills are used together.

Answer true only if one realistic user task would REQUIRE all three skills, each supplying a
distinct part of the work. Answer false if any one is optional, an alternative to another, or
a general version of another.

Reply with only a JSON object, no other text:
{"cooccur": true | false, "reason": "<at most 20 words>"}
